answer: Grove-mesa census bond: each agent posts 50 credits on a grove waypoint under a mesa. A census call sounds per epoch; the agent must wander to its waypoint and drop a marble in the urn in time. Marbles post publicly; one waypoint, one marble; a miss forfeits 10 credits. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 credits and 1,000 wanderers against a 40,000 pool. One rented body cannot cover 1,000 waypoints. Honest agents wander once, keep the bond.
